cpg.engine.db.mode.markdownDescription: How cpg obtains FalkorDB. Overrides `engine.db.mode` in `cpg.config.yaml`. Unset by default — falls through to `CPG_MODE` and then to the cpg dev instance default (`remote`).

cpg.engine.db.host.markdownDescription: FalkorDB host. Overrides `engine.db.host`. Unset by default — falls through to `CPG_HOST` and then `127.0.0.1`.

cpg.engine.db.port.markdownDescription: FalkorDB port. Overrides `engine.db.port`. Unset by default — falls through to `CPG_PORT` and then the cpg-owned dev instance, **6382**. NOT 6381 — that is the integration test harness (`bun run db:up`), which refuses any graph key not prefixed `cpg_test_`.

cpg.engine.db.graph.markdownDescription: Graph key. Overrides `engine.db.graph`. Unset by default — falls through to `CPG_GRAPH` and then `cpg`.
